    Bounded chains and good modules #

    ChainTo Y n X is a chain X → ⋯ → Y of n nonzero non-bijective maps between nonzero indecomposables. A module is good iff such chains have bounded length (Good.chain_bdd, good_of_bdd). This is the content of ASS IX.5.1 in the form used here.

    source
    inductive LargeIndecomposable.AR.ChainTo {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] (Y : FDMod k A) :
    ℕ → FDMod k A → Prop

    Chains of nonzero non-bijective maps ending at Y.
